name: runner-fallback
summary: Choose the runner from a repository variable, falling back to a hosted one, and check that no job hard-codes its runner.

variables.RUNNER_OS: Optional. The runner label every job should use, for example a self-hosted runner. When unset, jobs run on ubuntu-latest.

patches.change: Replace each `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` with `runs-on: ${{ vars.RUNNER_OS || 'ubuntu-latest' }}`. Mark any job that must stay on one specific machine with `# runner-fallback: exempt (why)`.
Optionally add a step that runs scripts/check-runner-fallback.sh. See the README.
